name: Matt Higgins
current_role: Co-founder & Executive Chairman, Performance Drone Works (PDW); co-founder & CEO, RSE Ventures
profile: Queens-born entrepreneur who co-founded RSE Ventures with Stephen Ross in 2012 (Resy, Drone Racing League, Momofuku/Milk Bar, Magnolia Bakery) after running business operations for the NY Jets and serving as Miami Dolphins vice chairman. He co-founded defense-drone maker PDW, a guest Shark on Shark Tank, and wrote the WSJ bestseller 'Burn the Boats' (2023).
interesting_fact: He dropped out of high school at 16 to care for his ailing mother, took night classes at Queens College, and became the youngest press secretary in New York City history under Mayor Giuliani, managing the city's media response to 9/11.
deep_cut_fact: He started out as an award-winning investigative reporter at the Queens Tribune, and in 2019 created the Linda Higgins Empowerment Scholarship at Queens College for single parents finishing degrees, named for his late mother.

public_contacts.value: Boyd Bailey, Reputable PR - boyd@reputablepr.com (PDW media contact)

notes: Very media-friendly (Shark Tank US and Dubai, commencement speeches, book tour), so a good podcast guest prospect. PDW angle: up-to-$820M conditional OSC loan for US drone-component manufacturing, and he led a PDW delegation to Ukraine.
